responsibility: This header implements GCC’s optional per-allocation-site memory statistics framework for container and allocator overhead tracking. It defines mem_location and mem_usage records, hashing and formatting of allocation sites, and the templated mem_alloc_description manager that maps source locations and live container/object pointers to accumulated allocation, peak, and count data, with APIs for registering descriptors, object overhead, releases, summaries, and formatted dumps. It is the core infrastructure behind GCC’s detailed memory-usage accounting by origin and source location.
